Marinos]] | {{flagicon|Brazil}} [[Marques (footballer, born 1973)|Marques]] | | | | {{flagicon|Brazil}} [[Eltinho]] | {{flagicon|Brazil}} ''[[Marcus Vinícius (footballer, born 1974)|Marcus Vinícius]]'' |} ==Format== Eighteen clubs will play in double round-robin (home and away) format, a total of 34 games each. A club receives 3 points for a win, 1 point for a tie, and 0 points for a loss. The clubs are ranked by points, and tie breakers are, in the following order: * Goal differential * Goals scored * Head-to-head results A draw would be conducted, if necessary. However, if two clubs are tied at the first place, both clubs will be declared as the champions. The bottom two clubs will be relegated to J2, while the 16th placed club plays a two-legged [[J.
